data.title: Higher Structures in Deep Learning
data.description: arXiv:2609.00472v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We provide an expository introduction on the importance of higher-arity tensor operations to deep learning. Then, we conduct a novel empirical investigation of higher-arity phenomenon in trained neural networks, introduce a hypergraphical generalization of the multilayer perceptron, and explore connections to evolutionary algorithms. We conclude with a discussion of promising directions for future research.
data.author: Michael L. Roberts, Carlos Zapata Carratal\'a. Nicholas J. Cooper, Lijun Chen, Fran\c{c}ois G. Meyer, Danna Gurari
